result.title: Transport along Local Annealing Paths: Wasserstein Geometry and Multimodal Sampling
result.summary: Variational approaches to learning transport maps for multimodal sampling can suffer from mode collapse. One way to mitigate this problem is to learn transport along a prescribed path of intermediate distributions defined by geometric annealing. We show that annealing can take a substantial detour in Wasserstein space: when mass moves between modes, the path can be much longer than the distance between its endpoints. We further link path geometry to transport learning, showing that long annealing paths can slow population optimization, while sufficiently regular paths permit rapid convergence. Motivated by these findings, we propose componentwise annealed transport (CAT) to reduce the need for mass transfer between modes. Starting from a mode-informed mixture reference, CAT constructs an exact mixture decomposition of the target and learns separate transport maps along componentwise annealing paths. We estimate the component weights separately and show that these estimates remain consistent even when the learned flows are inexact. We also develop adaptive annealing schedules guided by transport effort. Experiments on multimodal synthetic distributions and Bayesian inference problems demonstrate improvements in transport learning and sampling efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析几何退火路径在 Wasserstein 空间中的几何性质，指出模式间质量迁移会使路径远长于端点距离并拖慢优化，进而提出分量退火传输（CAT），以模式先验的混合参考构造目标的精确混合分解、分别学习各分量的传输映射，并用「传输努力」指导自适应退火调度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其混合分解、模式间质量迁移代价与按传输努力分配退火算力的思路，可能可供核查 latent 多假设表示的模式坍塌、假设间状态迁移以及动态计算/停止决策的评价方式，但需较多迁移论证。
